cues: He sits on the portico, smoking, saying this is what I call living.
He makes friends with the dogs and has no wish to fish or shoot.
A hostess whose skill is supplying what guests want has nothing to do, and she is piqued: her vanity is stung.
She leaves him alone; he does not mind.
So she forces her company on him, trying to break through his reserve.
